Whether CRH's serial-M&A compounding engine converts BOUGHT scale back into RETURNS - unchanged as the hinge but MATERIALLY ESCALATED by the 2026Q2 print: the ~$8.5B Arcosa agreement ("total enterprise value of approximately $8.5 billion", 2026Q2) is the largest deal in the company's history and is being funded in part by suspending the returns leg ("we have taken the decision to pause our share buyback program following the completion of the latest tranche"), so the question is now whether Adjusted ROIC stabilizes and re-rises off the FY2025 12.1% (down 130bps from 13.4%) as Eco
